## Problem Statement
A clear description of the problem or limitation you're experiencing.
Example: "I'm frustrated when I have to manually..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like.
Example: "It would be great if GHBot could..."

## Use Case
How would this feature be used in practice?
Example: "When I need to set up a new server, I would..."

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Constraints
- **RAM Impact**: [e.g., "Should work on 6 GB phone"]
- **Performance**: [e.g., "Must complete in under 5 seconds"]
- **Dependencies**: [e.g., "No external API calls"]

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] This feature fits the 4-pillar architecture (Build/Eyes/Manage/Interact)
- [ ] I have considered the 6 GB phone constraint
- [ ] I understand this is a volunteer-maintained project
